TPCdesign: Design Informative Thermal Performance Experiments

Source: R/TPCdesign-package.R
TPCdesign-package.Rd

Tools to choose experimental temperatures that are maximally informative for fitting thermal performance curves (TPCs). Given rough prior guesses at a Brière-2 TPC's parameters, design_temps() uses an approximate coordinate-exchange (ACE) algorithm to search for the set of temperatures that minimizes the expected uncertainty in fitted TPC parameters, and sim_gamma_data() simulates data from that curve for testing a design.

Main functions

  • design_temps(): Choose a set of temperatures to sample from.

  • sim_gamma_data(): Simulate performance data with observation error at a set of temperatures.

  • briere2_tpc(): Evaluate the Brière-2 TPC.

  • briere2_tpc_Topt(): Compute the thermal optimum of a Brière-2 TPC.
